scope: Read-only fixed native CLI and framework dump review; not actual image or device-capability acceptance

processCommandReview.selection: -A includes all discoverable process entries; no grep or package filter
processCommandReview.width: -w suppresses individual field width truncation, but fixed source still has a 99999 character display row width; argv acquisition itself is bounded by applet implementation
processCommandReview.identity: UID numeric, PID, PPID; NAME derives PID argv[0], while CMD is task stat comm and could truncate the long package name; ARGS is CMDLINE minus initial path
processCommandReview.limits: ps snapshot is not atomic, can miss exited/hidden/unreadable entries; outputs are not proof of continuous process absence or binding state

limits: Default selected component alone does not establish a running or bound InputMethodService.
The full dump can query other client/service processes using TransferPipe and report local IPC failures; exit0 is not itself a complete semantic snapshot.
Concurrent state can change across different sections and across PID/ps/dump/PID reads.
Reference-source field names may differ on actual image; preserve original bytes and treat unknown fields/partial dumps conservatively.

previousRun.inference: Only no exact-name PID result at that query; no specific cold-start/binding cause or ART capability tested.

reviewRequirements: Append only after primary completed/exit1/zero output, after original device/default/package gates.
Persist original failure before append and never allow context or second PID to promote profile admission.
Retain fixed original32 profile path and command/output/trace limits; failed branch at most16 commands.
Append at most ps, unfiltered input_method, exact-name pidof once each in fixed order; no UI/show/APK/settings/root/property/permission changes.
Preserve per-command timeout/nonzero/limited output and partial receipts; cancellation prevents later dispatch.
Replay binds initial trigger and exclusive failed branch, prevents forged diagnostics mixed with native profile path.
actualRunReview: pending frozen-source single execution; no device/CI by reviewer
